covers: Hand recipe (kind repro-steps) for SC-00, authored by muse-b3 as author of record (GB-1555 + CB-0824 SC-foundations runway) from the fixer's check file: /Users/dutch/.zuko/quality/CHECK-SC-00.md (seat B2, branch v1/sc-foundations, build 10c2e066c18b27e839e8f4d72e2400fe72f8b961, parent exactly 0f00e554d — the SC-05 landing on sx/core-loop, on which this branch is based so the direct path inherits SC-05's input-integrity arming by construction; the bridge file is byte-identical between that base and deployed main 21303b4672, so the bridge leg applies to the deployed build unchanged; FPV at dossier line 1051). Defect: no solve.direct entry existed — grep over the deployed server/ tree for solve.direct / solveDirect returns zero hits, and conkay_solve (the only solve surface) required a Design IR or designId, so no solver was reachable from typed inputs alone (CB-0808: SC-00 NOT SATISFIED). Fix (5 files): server/lib/conkay/solve-direct.js (NEW) — solveDirect(solverId, spec) validates the typed inputs at its boundary (the SC-04 seam, see SC-04's recipe), builds the minimal in-memory Design IR for one node, and runs the production machinery entire (openDesign -> DesignEngine -> envelope), returning the solver's envelope(s); unknown solver returns { ok:false, reason:"unknown_solver" }, never a throw; a solver with no applicable targets returns NOT_COMPUTED with empty results, honestly. server/lib/mcp-execution-bridge.js routes { solver_id, inputs } with no ir/designId through the same validation + IR construction and then its normal compile -> open -> settle -> signing pipeline; dry_run previews over typed inputs too. Plus the behaviour suite server/tests/conkay-sc00-solve-direct.test.js, SC-04's suite, and the doc entry docs/conkay/sc-00-solve-direct.md. Evidence of record (checker-verifiable at the landed head): suite 8/8 PASS in the built tree; landed extract @ 10c2e066c runs SC-00 + SC-04 + SC-05 suites 28/28 PASS; pristine control (deployed main 21303b4672 extract) fails at import (solve-direct.js absent). Regression: the full conkay-* family (163 files) built 1,510 tests · 1,376 pass / 55 fail / 79 skip vs pristine-base 1,489 · 1,355 / 55 / 79 — the delta is exactly the +21 new tests, all passing; the 55 failures are the standing environmental set, identical on both sides. Value-assertion provenance: INDEPENDENT — the direct path's beam.fea envelope is asserted byte-equal to the IR path's own envelope on the same design (maxDeflection 0.00450911598961386 m), not to a copied constant. Named limits, carried entire: one node per direct call; multi-node solvers return their own NOT_COMPUTED on this path (documented in the doc entry).
discriminator: Pre-fix transcript (from CHECK-SC-00.md; premise executed against the deployed build 21303b4672): the direct entry does not exist — the behaviour suite fails at import (Cannot find module '.../server/lib/conkay/solve-direct.js'), grep over the deployed server/ tree for solve.direct / solveDirect returns ZERO hits, and conkay_solve without an ir/designId cannot solve from typed inputs. Post-fix: suite 8/8 PASS; the substitutor probe echoing E = 190 GPa against the declared 200 GPa is refused input_substituted:E on the direct path (the SC-05 arming inherited by construction).
steps: Call solveDirect("beam.fea", the evidence beam spec: i-beam 4 m x 300 mm, steel-a992, simply supported, 60 kN point load): the returned envelope PASSes and outputs.maxDeflection.value == 0.00450911598961386, byte-equal to the IR path's own envelope on the same design.
Call solveDirect with an unknown solver id: it returns { ok:false, reason:"unknown_solver" } and does not throw.
Call solveDirect for a solver with no applicable targets on the spec's node: NOT_COMPUTED with empty results.

Register a substitutor echoing E = 190 GPa against the declared 200 GPa and call it through solveDirect: NOT_COMPUTED with reason input_substituted:E (supplied 200000000000, used 190000000000) — the SC-05 arming inherited by construction.
Through the MCP bridge, submit { solver_id, inputs } with no ir/designId: it solves end to end; with dry_run it previews 1 target.
title: solve.direct solves a registered solver from typed inputs without a Design IR, under the same envelope and integrity contract as the IR path
